description: Enterprise techniques used by SIGHTGRAB, ATT&CK software S9058 (v1.0)
name: SIGHTGRAB (S9058)

techniques.comment: [SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has autonomously captured screen shots at regular intervals.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has captured and staged stolen data in folders named using a captured timestamp in the format of YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has saved captured screenshots of victim devices to `C:\Users\Public` prior to exfiltration.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has leveraged Windows Native API keys to execute functions to include `LoadLibraryA` and `GetProcessAddress`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has used XOR encrypted strings with a single-byte key of 0x41.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has captured screenshots of victim devices and has saved them incrementally within created folders.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[SIGHTGRAB](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9058) has gathered the compromised victims time to be used in the naming conventions of created folders.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
